subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed root cause fix is completely absent. The RCA requires: (1) importing ContentstackLivePreview from '@contentstack/live-preview-utils', (2) calling ContentstackLivePreview.init() at module level, and (3) replacing the static context with useState + useEffect subscribing to onEntryChange callbacks so CMS-pushed preview updates re-render all 236+ useContent consumers. Instead, the code explicitly states the SDK 'is not installed' and implements a URL-param-based approach (readLivePreviewFromLocation) that only reads `live_preview` and `preview_token` query params once on mount. No CMS-pushed content updates ever reach components. The `ContentstackContext` (which supplies all content) remains a static `createContext<IContentstackContext>({})` with no subscription mechanism. None of the four verification criteria requiring live preview behavior (malformed updates don't break rendering, real-time content updates) can be satisfied because no live preview data path exists.
issues.suggestedFix: Install @contentstack/live-preview-utils (or request the dependency addition as a prerequisite), then implement the prescribed minimal fix: import ContentstackLivePreview, call init() at module level, and replace the static content context with useState + useEffect that subscribes to onEntryChange to update the content state object, keeping defaultContent as initial state. Remove the URL-param-based ILivePreviewContext/readLivePreviewFromLocation/ContentstackProvider code — it does not enable live preview.

issues.description: The entire test file (179 lines, 10 test cases) is deleted with no replacement. The review criteria require that new features have corresponding vitest unit tests and that the total test count is not decreased. This change reduces the test count by 10. No new test file is added anywhere in the diff to cover the live preview integration.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a new test file (e.g., src/context/ContentstackContext.spec.tsx) that tests the actual live preview behavior: mock @contentstack/live-preview-utils, verify onEntryChange callbacks update content state, verify unchanged fields persist, verify malformed updates don't break rendering, verify non-preview sessions show correct content, and verify exiting preview restores content.

issues.description: Concursion & Reuse: The change does not address the prescribed root cause. The RCA states 'This is the single provider that supplies all content to the entire app... It currently creates a static, immutable context from defaultContent (fetched once at build time via getStaticProps) and never subscribes to Contentstack Live Preview SDK updates.' The diff adds a ContentstackProvider that provides only a LivePreviewContext (isLivePreview boolean + previewToken string) but does NOT wrap or enhance the existing ContentstackContext that carries actual content. The provider doesn't accept defaultContent as a prop. A more concise change that actually meets the AC: add SDK init + onEntryChange subscription inside the existing content provider (fewer lines than the current diff's new ILivePreviewContext + readLivePreviewFromLocation + LivePreviewContext + ContentstackProvider, and actually functional).
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the new ContentstackProvider/LivePreviewContext/readLivePreviewFromLocation code. Instead, modify the existing content delivery mechanism (the component that creates ContentstackContext.Provider with defaultContent) to use useState + useEffect with SDK onEntryChange subscription, as prescribed.

issues.description: TypeScript strict compliance: The existing `header?: [any]` and `footer?: [any]` and `pageSpecificData?: Record<string, any>` use untyped `any` without explanatory comments. While these are pre-existing, the diff touches this interface and should not perpetuate untyped any.
issues.suggestedFix: Add explanatory comments for the any types or replace with proper types (at minimum `unknown[]` for header/footer).

issues.description: ContentstackLink destructures `{ getContentByKey, isLivePreview, previewToken }` from useContent(), but the diff does not show changes to useContent.ts to expose isLivePreview/previewToken. If these fields were added to useContent without being shown in the diff, that change is unreviewed. If they were pre-existing, they reference the now-deleted IContentstackLivePreview shape. Either way, the useContent hook must be updated to expose live preview state from the actual SDK integration, not from URL params.
issues.suggestedFix: Update useContent.ts to derive isLivePreview/previewToken from the SDK-integrated content context (once the prescribed fix is implemented), and include that change in the diff for review.
